title: Why is times five the same as times ten, then half?
description: Eight groups of ten dots are halved to show why a number times five equals the number times ten, divided by two. Keeko then raises a hand, thinking eight times five is eighty.
teaching_notes: One idea: a group of five is half a group of ten, so times five is times ten, then half. Ask the class to picture eight groups of five dots before the groups of ten are drawn. Watch for students who stop at the times ten answer and forget the halving.

source: Using the meaning of multiplication and division, can you explain why multiplying by 5 is the same as dividing by 2 and multiplying by 10?
video_script.why: The child has used the shortcut to find products, and now explains why it works using groups.
video_script.substitution: Replace each group of 5 by a group of 10 and halve the total: n × 5 = (n × 10) ÷ 2.
video_script.anchor: Eight rows of dots, each row five dots, beside the line 8 × 5.
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko sees 8 groups of 10 dots make 80 and says eight times five is eighty. Each group has only 5 dots, so the total is half of 80.
video_script.payoff_line: Times five is times ten and then half

final_answer.value: 5 = 10 ÷ 2, so times 5 is times 10 then halve, e.g. 8 × 5 = 40
final_answer.spoken: five is ten divided by two, so times five is times ten and then halve, for example eight times five is forty

never_show: the product of 8 × 5 before the answer beat
maths_rules: 5 is half of 10, so a group of 5 is half a group of 10
8 × 5 is half of 80, which is 4 tens, that is 40

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step three, the kept dots are half of all the dots. Eight groups of five are half of eight groups of ten.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Half of eighty dots is four tens, because eight tens halve into four tens.

beats.on_screen: Answer: 5 = 10 ÷ 2, so times 5 is times 10 then halve; for example 8 × 5 = 40

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Keeko thinks eight times five is eighty, because eight groups of ten make eighty.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But every group has only five dots, not ten.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>The total must be half of eighty, so the answer cannot be eighty.
